notes.content:
[p]Squadmates...

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Fixes / QOL[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Melee attacks don’t hit sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]Made tutorial instructions legible on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Russian keyboard displays wrong input prompts.[/p][/*][*][p]Hostages don’t follow players between floors.[/p][/*][*][p]Changing healing target mid-healing now cancels the healing instead of healing new target. notes.title: Bundles – Tactical Value, Unlimited Opportunities
notes.content:
[p]Gather round, squadmates! [/p][p][b]We've paired Phantom Squad with a selection of standout indie title that shares our love for tactics, tension and tight gameplay.[/b][/p][p]Whether you're into stealth, surreal shooters, strategic survival or old-school undead-blasting mayhem, there’s a bundle here with your name on it. Here's the breakdown:[/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/2c0632f8faa1fcc71dcafa3030bcd9847ffc1241.png"][/img][/p][p]
Intruder is an immersive, team-based stealth FPS focused on infiltration, teamwork and environmental espionage. Use silenced weapons, gadgets like mirror cameras and motion sensors, and proximity chat to coordinate with your squad. Dive through vents, disable security systems and execute silent takedowns in tense, emergent multiplayer encounters.[/p][p][b]To celebrate this partnership, we are hosting a Discord Raid on both Intruder and Phantom Squad Discord servers where 10 lucky players can win Intruder + Phantom Squad Bundles! Simply join both servers [/b][url="https://discord.gg/zbZGWgYsvu"]here[/url][b] and [/b][url="https://discord.gg/zQU5w8Fuq8"]here[/url][b] over the next 24 hours and share where you've come from or what you're most exited about. Then say "Intruder" or "Phantom Squad" in chat and winners will be randomly selected![/b] [/p][p]To continue this partnership further, [b]both the Intruder and Phantom Squad developers will be hosting an AMA on Reddit's r/gaming on Tuesday July 22nd at 6pm BST![/b] If you've ever wanted to know what goes on into making tactical games like these, and what the future holds for them, be sure to join us![/p][p]It’s a perfect match for Phantom Squad players who want to continue testing their tactical thinking, this time in the shadows. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56394/Intruder__Phantom_Squad/"]Pick it up here now, at over 30% off until August 1. [/url]

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/3432c116b1c1c5eb0c307e7098eceaf416412f10.png"][/img][/p][p]
Much like Phantom Squad, you need a solid plan A in No Plan B, a tactical top-down shooter where every decision counts. Assemble your squad, draw up the perfect plan using an innovative timeline system and watch your orders play out in real time. But be warned, one wrong move could spell disaster.[/p][p]With roguelike campaign paths, faction choice (from SWAT teams to criminals), equipment customisation and cinematic replay options, it delivers intense strategic gameplay. It shares Phantom Squad’s focus on meticulous coordination and split-second timing, only from above. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56280/Phantom_Squad__No_Plan_B/"]Pick up this duo at over 15% off here, [/url][/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/adb1d3d2d3098e4dd4b85aa54f61e1fe965c4ab3.png"][/img][/p][p]
OXTO is a high-intensity, black-and-white roguelite shooter set in a supernatural mansion. You play as an unnamed hero on a mission to rescue a loved one. Expect fast, brutal gunplay, focus-based time-slow abilities, randomly generated levels, and a striking film-noir pixel art style accented with vivid splashes of red.[/p][p]After a tense firefight in Phantom Squad, OXTO offers a shift in pace that is frenetic, stylish and endlessly replayable. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56378/Phantom_Squad__OTXO/"]Grab it before time runs out, at over 40% off here. [/url]
[/p][p]So if the base game wasn’t enough, or if you want to gift the bundle to a fellow squadmate, be sure to pick them up now![/p][p] See you on the field, 
The Phantom Squad Team.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Mission Objective Overview | Dev Diary #4
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Agents 🫡[/p][p][/p][p]The enemy moves fast - and we need you to move faster. Throughout Phantom Squad, you’ll be deployed across a range of mission objectives in the fight against global terrorist operations.[/p][p][/p][p]We never send our agents into the field without intel, so here’s an overview of some of the mission types you’ll be facing.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Neutralising Hostiles[/b][/p][p]One of the most effective ways to stop the enemy is to eliminate them. Some missions will require you to clear multiple floors of hostile forces - whether that’s silently from a distance with a suppressed weapon, or up close with a shotgun. The method is up to you. Just get it done.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/b80f09f9ccdad49846739deff7e76abc09e9a2fa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hostage Rescue[/b][/p][p]Terrorists don’t play fair. They’ll risk innocent lives as a means to their end. At times, you’ll be charged with the safety of these hostages. Plan carefully, move fast, and aim with precision and make sure the innocents make it out alive.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/4955ae4d0e7ad7cf2b94c606d8242e305af121fc.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Bomb Defusal [/b][/p][p]Some enemies are willing to take themselves out if it furthers their cause. You’ll need to sweep buildings under strict time pressure and prevent detonation - not only to save lives, but to secure critical intel before it’s lost.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/1c7d53c97c012b7a83066530869dbe9fb20a7c1f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Prepared for all of this - and more?
[/p][p]Wishlist us below, before we release fully this July 18th. 👇[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841770/Phantom_Squad/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Assault Coordination Engine | Dev Diary #3
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Agents 🫡[/p][p]
In previous Dev Diaries, you may have seen references to the Assault Coordination Engine. Today, we’ll be walking through how to make best use of it to support your squad in the field.[/p][p]
When you and your team arrive at a mission site, the first thing you’ll want to do is check your A.C.E. It provides a general overview of the terrain, along with key intel from Command. This may include suspected areas of heavy enemy presence, potential bomb placements, hostage locations - and more.[/p][p]
But the A.C.E. isn’t just a map. It’s your primary planning tool.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/0c219321092ad28cc9bdbd856b4459942c1e5095.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Working together with your squad, you can draw routes directly onto the A.C.E., as well as use a combination of tactical icons to mark up important details. If an enemy caught you off guard and compromised your mission, it’s worth marking that location with a warning icon for future attempts.[/p][p][/p][p]The A.C.E. also integrates directly with your gadgets. Using tools like the Drone and Door Cam, you’ll be able to spot and flag enemy positions for your team - helping you either steer clear of danger or plan for a clean takedown.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/b56b6fabe6e3e621e70f731794cffdd1dd37cb88.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ready to lead your own Phantom Squad?
[/p][p]Follow the link below to play the Demo now 👇[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841770/Phantom_Squad/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: The Criminal Underworld of Phantom Squad | Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings, Agents 🫡[/b][/p][p][/p][p]It’s time you learnt more about your mission - and the threats you’ll be facing in Phantom Squad.[/p][p]First, you should know a little more about the team you’re working with. In the wake of a catastrophic terrorist attack, a high-ranking officer established an off-the-books unit designed to combat threats with full autonomy.[/p][p][/p][p]Composed of operatives officially tied to no nation, your unit exists solely to fight terrorism - wherever it emerges. Together with your Squad, you’ll be expected to use any means necessary to complete the mission.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/0195b17761de20853182e10122f452d109875ee8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Your experience has more than prepared you for the first op - rescuing civilians held hostage in a downtown skyscraper. But it won’t be long before you’re deployed into unfamiliar territory, facing more complex, better-coordinated terrorist networks.[/p][p][/p][p]After a successful mission extracting a high-value individual, lines between different enemy organisations will rapidly become blurred as you uncover an international web of threats, whose ultimate target could plunge the world as we know it into disorder and chaos.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/474f7090567ffabfcd7be10700c7934c161f8e5b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So now that you know who your team is, and what you’re up against, only one question remains - are you ready?[/p][p][/p][p]Play our Demo and Wishlist Phantom Squad below. 👇[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841770/Phantom_Squad/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: What Inspired Phantom Squad? | Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Greetings, Soldiers 🫡

I first announced that I was working on Phantom Squad over a year ago. It’s been a lot of hard work -  but with launch now firmly in my sights, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on why I set out on this mission in the first place.

From day one, the objective was clear: build a co-op game that bridges the gap between the high action of Hotline Miami and the tactical planning of Rainbow Six. Coordinated assaults, careful planning, and squad cohesion are central to Phantom Squad - but so is the chaos that unfolds when those plans go sideways, and you're forced to adapt on the fly to keep your team alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/0ded61bb2e4cf5354ed6a8d5bf408bdd56701b2f.gif[/img]

If you’ve played Rainbow Six, you’ll recognise certain key elements. First and foremost: tactical, team-based gameplay. In Phantom Squad, those who plan, communicate, and move as a unit will survive. Those who charge in headfirst? They’ll be the first to fall.

Another core pillar: gadget-focused strategy. At mission start, intel is minimal - just a building layout accessed through A.C.E. You’ll need to deploy gadgets smartly, coordinating with your squad to scout enemy positions, mark patrol routes, and plan your breach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/96629376685b68a4e040f4d216a741945cd0270d.gif[/img]

Fans of tactical shooters more broadly will appreciate the loadout customisation available in Phantom Squad. Each operative can customise their kit, optimising for the mission ahead while developing their own preferred combat style. Get knocked down? Your squad can pick you back up again a limited number of times - but only if they’re able to get to you. Attempting to get you back on your feet in hostile territory could get your squadmate dropped. No heroics without backup.

And while tactics are at the heart of Phantom Squad, the influence of Hotline Miami is never far away. Players and NPCs alike hit hard, and combat is unforgiving. Quick deaths. Quick retries. Learn fast, regroup, and hit back harder. You will die - frequently - but it’ll always feel fair. Every failure teaches you something. Every reset brings you closer to execution perfection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921627/c68bff40310bf98f670d2943cead996c5ec678df.gif[/img]

So with all that said, I hope you’re as fired up for Phantom Squad as I am. There’s plenty more intel to come over the next few weeks. Until then, wishlist the game and play the demo via the link below 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841770/Phantom_Squad/
